Package org.apache.juneau.commons.secret

Interface SensitivePropertySource

All Superinterfaces:
PropertySource
All Known Implementing Classes:
SecretStorePropertySource
public interface SensitivePropertySource extends PropertySource
Marker specialization of PropertySource whose values are sensitive and must be redacted anywhere they would otherwise be surfaced — a toString(), a settings dump, or a log line.

This marker is the seam that keeps the opt-in SecretStorePropertySource bridge from leaking bridged secrets: a dump/log path that iterates PropertySources should test src instanceof SensitivePropertySource and redact rather than print resolved values. The marker is scoped to the bridge on purpose — it is not forced across all of Settings.
